description: This Java class 'JwtAuthenticationFactory' provides a factory for creating JWT-related security components, including validators and public key providers, within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating JWT authentication components such as validators and key providers.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of JwtAuthenticationFactory with specified OAuth configuration, cache configuration, and HTTP client facade.

methods.name: getJwtValidator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JwtValidator.

methods.name: getPublicKeyProvider
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PublicKeyProvider.

methods.name: getJwtSubjectIssuersConfig
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: newJwtAuthenticationResultProvider
methods.description: Creates a new JwtAuthenticationResultProvider using the JWT subject issuers.
